findings.title: Adobe Audience Manager set an advertising cookie "demdex" under gpc consent
findings.detail: Adobe Audience Manager wrote "demdex" on .demdex.net before consent was granted.
findings.remediation: Block Adobe Audience Manager until consent is granted. If it comes from an embed, use the privacy-enhanced or consent-gated variant.

findings.title: Amazon Advertising fires under gpc consent
findings.detail: Amazon Advertising (advertising) loaded and sent data while consent was gpc.
findings.remediation: Gate Amazon Advertising behind consent (Consent Mode default-denied or CMP blocking) so it does not fire until the visitor opts in.
